capabilities: Send the whole document or a selection to the Antidote corrector
Open the Antidote dictionary and language guides
Show corrector, dictionary and guide icons in the status bar
Run corrector, dictionary and guide commands from the command palette
disambiguation: Not a grammar checker itself; it only forwards text to the separate Antidote application and does nothing without it.
extras: Unofficial integration not made by Druide; on Linux only Antidote 10 is available, so the Connectix 11 upgrade is mandatory there; does not work on smartphones; README covers Connectix 11 installation workarounds and troubleshooting steps.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in grammar checking, and Antidote's official integrations cover other software but not Obsidian.

relations.evidence: This plugin is only a bridge between Obsidian and Antidote: it corrects nothing by itself
Connectix is what links Antidote to its integrations (Word, VS Code, your browser, Obsidian, etc.)

requires.name: Antidote 10+ license or Antidote Web purchase

summary: Bridge to the Antidote grammar checker that sends notes or selections to its corrector, dictionary and guides from status bar icons and commands.
